body: The trees thicken around me, their leaves rustling ominously in the wind. The air grows colder, each breath bringing a sharp chill. I see no movement or sound except for the faint hum of distant machinery. My heart pounds as an overwhelming fear grips my chest—this can't be happening again. With one hand on my sword at the ready, I turn towards the source of the voices inside the forest, hoping against hope that this time, they're not chasing me.
